messages.subject: Package for Interactive Graphs / Tooltips?
parts:
Hello,

I am interested in using R to create simple graphs to visualize data
in a web browser. None of the graphs I need to make are terribly
sophisticated (simple scatter plots, bar graphs). However, I would
like to find an R package that allows the user to interact with the
graphs to do things along the lines of:

1. alter color of lines
2. select/unselect samples or series to show
3. show tooltips on mouse hover for each data point to provide use
with more info (like value of datapoint)

This list just gives some examples of the sort of things I'm trying to
investigate. Can anyone recommend R packages for this sort of thing?
I'm assuming this means the package outputs the graph as
HTML/javascript, but this may not always be the case.

I've come across the following candidates:

RGraph
http://www.rgraph.net/docs/index.html

Playwith
http://code.google.com/p/playwith/

There are probably others. Any help or suggestions would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Ben
